# Silent H

> Silent H is a modern Mexican restaurant and tequila bar at 461 King Street West in Toronto's Entertainment District (King West). Executive Chef Gerardo Álvarez Saucedo serves elevated Mexican food; the hidden late-night lounge Aitch is a Patron house, pouring Patron, Don Julio and Clase Azul with guest DJs Thursday to Sunday.

## Key facts
- Location: 461 King Street West, Toronto, ON, Canada (King West)
- Phone: +1 416-900-3535
- Hours: Dinner Tuesday to Sunday from 5pm; happy hour daily 5-7pm ($10 margaritas)
- Cuisine: Modern Mexican
- Executive Chef: Gerardo Álvarez Saucedo
- Reservations: https://www.opentable.ca/r/silent-h-toronto

## Pages
- [Menu](https://www.silenth.ca/menu): Modern Mexican food, tacos, and cocktails
- [Happy Hour](https://www.silenth.ca/happy-hour): Daily 5-7pm, $10 margaritas and $4 bites
- [Aitch](https://www.silenth.ca/aitch): Hidden late-night tequila bar and Patron house pouring Patron, Don Julio and Clase Azul
- [Events & Private Dining](https://www.silenth.ca/events): Private events and full buyouts
- [Our Story](https://www.silenth.ca/story): About Silent H and Chef Gerardo Álvarez Saucedo
- [FAQ](https://www.silenth.ca/faq): Common questions about visiting Silent H
- [Blog](https://www.silenth.ca/blogs): Guides to Mexican food, agave spirits, and Toronto dining
